title: Dataverse security role (*.dv.security.yaml under roles/)
description: One security role of the root business unit and its complete privilege set. A privilege the file doesn't list is revoked by apply.

level.description: Access level: none, user (Basic), business_unit (Local), parent_child (Deep) or organization (Global).

name.description: Role name — the role's identity in the root business unit (case-insensitive).

description.description: Role description. Left out = not managed.

member_inheritance.description: Member's privilege inheritance (isinherited): team_only or direct_and_team. Left out = not managed.

tables.description: Table privileges, keyed by table logical name. A verb left out has no access.

privileges.description: Other privileges (miscellaneous, privacy-related…), keyed by privilege name.
